name: U-Haul Self-Storage
notes: Researched from the public U-Haul storage-rent article, the Self-Storage FAQ and the sign-in page (no sign-in). Sign-in takes a phone number or email with a password, or a one-time code instead; the dossier models email + password (the one-time-code path cannot be expressed). Storage rent is paid under My Rentals/Reservations > Pay Rent (web) or Orders > More Details > Pay Rent (app), by phone with a representative (1-800-468-4285) or at the facility. Online payment methods are Visa/Mastercard/Discover/Amex; cash, checks and ACH at participating locations, so billing.methods keeps the family default. Auto Pay enrollment is under My Rentals/Reservations > Manage Auto Pay. Rent is due on the move-in date each month, is not prorated, and late fees vary by location (not modelled). Move-out: tell storage staff, empty the unit and remove the lock; no online move-out is described, so cancel_service is unsupported online. No paperless page exists. Reviewer 2026-10-09: "View Payment Receipts" could not be confirmed on public pages; the storage article lists payment receipts as an account feature, so the label is now "Payment Receipts". Sign-in page shows "Phone or Email", "Sign In With Password" and "Send Me a One-Time Code".

sources.title: How to Pay Your Storage Unit Rent | U-Haul

cancel_service.note: To move out, tell the storage facility staff so billing stops, empty and clean the unit, and remove your lock. You can also call 1-800-GO-U-HAUL (1-800-468-4285).

help.title: How to pay your storage rent
paragraphs: Sign in to your U-Haul account, open My Rentals/Reservations, select your storage rental and choose Pay Rent. In the U-Haul app, open the rental from the home screen or the Orders tab, tap More Details and then Pay Rent.

You can also pay at your storage facility during office hours, call the facility, or call 1-800-GO-U-HAUL (1-800-468-4285) to pay with a representative. U-Haul accepts Visa, Mastercard, Discover and American Express; cash, checks and ACH are taken at participating locations.
steps: Sign in with your phone number or email.
Choose Pay Rent and submit the payment.

help.title: Set up Auto Pay
paragraphs: Sign in, open My Rentals/Reservations, find your storage contract number and choose Manage Auto Pay, then enter your payment details. Staff can also enroll you at move-in or during office hours.
Auto Pay usually fails because a card has expired or an account has insufficient funds, so check your payment details before the next due date.

help.title: Due dates and late rent
paragraphs: Rent is due every month on the same date as your move-in. Rent is not prorated: each payment covers you until the next due date.
A late or missed payment adds a late fee that varies by location and region, and you may lose access to your unit until the balance is paid.

help.title: Moving out of your storage unit
paragraphs: Let the storage staff know you are moving out so you are not billed again. Take out all of your belongings, leave the room clean to avoid a cleaning fee, and remove your lock.

help.title: Reaching a storage representative
paragraphs: Text the word Storage to 1-800-664-5017 to reach a live representative, or call 1-800-GO-U-HAUL (1-800-468-4285).

extra.intent: Find the number U-Haul says you can text to reach a live self-storage representative. Do not make a payment or change any settings.
Using U-Haul's self-storage help, find which day of the month storage rent is due. Do not make a payment or change any settings.

solution.text: Rent is due each month on the same date as your move-in date.
